edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff a settlement amount to be agreed by the parties in writing (the “Settlement Amount”). The payment deadline, method, and instructions remain subject to agreement.

2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims asserted in the dispute described in the Recitals. The scope of the release remains subject to the parties’ agreement.
3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except for disclosures required by law or necessary to obtain legal or tax advice or to enforce this Agreement.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims asserted in the dispute between them (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff a settlement amount to be agreed by the parties in writing (the “Settlement Amount”). Plaintiff proposes that payment be made within 30 calendar days after execution of this Agreement by both parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. The Settlement Amount and payment timing remain subject to agreement.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant solely from the claims asserted in the Dispute. No other claims are released, and nothing in this release limits either party’s right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its professional advisers, as required by law, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party disclosing terms to its professional advisers shall inform them of their confidential nature and instruct them to maintain confidentiality, subject to disclosures required by law. These obligations apply equally to both parties.
